name: freerouting-rs
description: Autorouter for KiCad (Rust port of Freerouting)
description_full: Routes the open board with freerouting-rs, a Rust port of the Freerouting autorouter. The toolbar button exports the board as a Specctra DSN, runs the bundled router with live progress and imports the resulting session back into the board. Binaries for Windows (x86_64), macOS (universal) and Linux (x86_64) are included; no Java is needed. It is independent of the Java Freerouting plugin and can be installed beside it.
